# Stones: the rockfall's boulder pile in the cave's green, for scenery (tan is kept for the hazard).
new
material new Stone --base-color 0.259 0.431 0.365 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name B1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.34 --location -0.18 0.05 0.28
add mesh ico-sphere --name B2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.28 --location 0.22 -0.1 0.22
add mesh ico-sphere --name B3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.22 --location 0.1 0.22 0.45
select B1 B2 B3
active B1
join
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 5
mode object
rename B1 Pile
material assign Stone
shade flat
export stones.glb
